title: ATO criticised for 'not going in to bat' for millions of Australians underpaid super
paragraphs: Workers and industry experts are calling on the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) to be more "proactive" in responding to unpaid superannuation claims.
Data shows one in four workers are underpaid super, and only 15 per cent of that is recovered by the ATO.
The ATO says it is "serious" about ensuring employers are paying super.
